description:
This is a screenshot of a user interface for the "Add Ingestion" process, specifically illustrating Step 2: 'Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Raster'. The form presents input fields for metadata and options for uploading raster data.

The top section indicates a two-step process, with Step 1 "Input Type Selection" marked as completed (grey '1') and Step 2 "'Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Raster'" as active (green '2').

The form includes the following input fields:
*   "Name*"
*   "Country*"
*   "Region" (with placeholder text "Select a country")

Below these fields are two tabs: "File Upload" (currently active) and "URL Upload". The "File Upload" section provides a drag-and-drop area with an "UPLOAD DATASET/S" button. Supported file types listed are .tif, .TIF, .tiff, .TIFF, .zip, .h5, and .gpkg.

At the bottom, there are radio button options for dataset characteristics and resolution:
*   "Discrete values"
*   "Continuous values"
*   "100 meters"
*   "10 meters" (currently selected with a green dot)

The discrete/continuous values refer to the nature of the data, such as high-resolution layer (HRL) products like Water and Wetness (WAW) consisting of discrete objects, or Tree Cover Density (TCD) and Imperviousness Density (IMD) representing continuous values.
